role: very bright star (2MASS Ks about 5.5), expected to saturate

queries.simbad_tap: SELECT main_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, otype FROM basic WHERE main_id = 'HD 189733' OR main_id = '* HD 189733'
queries.irsa_tap_coverage: SELECT a.uri, p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_lower, p.time_bounds_upper, p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 300.18213726, 22.71085365), p.poly) ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
